merge: Land item work and check merge readiness.
merge audit: Report which items are ready to merge, changing nothing.
merge item: Land a verified item lane through the merge policy.
merge receipt: Add facts to an item's merge receipt.
merge receipt commits: Tie outside commits to an item's merge receipt.
merge receipt commits attest: Credit a commit made outside Yoke to an item.
merge review: Review merge candidates before they land.
merge review candidate: Check whether a candidate commit may land.
merge review candidate evaluate: Check whether a commit may land, and request review.
